chunks: And everything in it that is from Jabir ibn Yazid Al-Ju'fi, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh - may Allah be pleased with him - from his uncle Muhammad ibn Abi Al-Qasim, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid Al-Barqi, from his father, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir ibn Yazid Al-Ju'fi.

key_terms.الْبَرْقِيُّ: Al-Barqi, referring to Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid Al-Barqi.
key_terms.جَابِرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الْجَعْفِيِّ: Jabir ibn Yazid Al-Ju'fi, a prominent companion of the Imams whose narrations are cited.
key_terms.عَمْرُو بْنِ شَمْرٍ: Amr ibn Shimr, a narrator in the chain.
key_terms.مَاجِيلَوَيْهَ: Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh, a key narrator in the chain.

ai.seo_question: Who is the narrator chain for Jabir ibn Yazid Al-Ju'fi in this text?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq provides a detailed isnad (chain of transmission) to authenticate narrations from Jabir ibn Yazid al-Ju'fi, a prominent companion of the Imams known for his extensive knowledge. By tracing the lineage through figures like Majillawayh and al-Burqi, he underscores the reliability of the transmission within the Shia scholarly tradition, linking the early Imams' teachings to later compilers.
